title: Spectral Chess of the Damned
description: A dark surreal painting depicts a glowing chessboard with luminous yellow pieces, some of which are tadpole-like or sperm-shaped. In the shadowy background, multiple anguished human faces with open mouths emerge from the darkness, while a bright yellow streak resembling a comet or laser cuts across the upper portion, scattering golden particles.
prompt: A surreal dark painting of a glowing yellow chessboard on a wooden surface with unusual sperm and tadpole-shaped chess pieces. Several anguished screaming human faces emerge from the black shadowy background above the board. A bright yellow comet streak cuts diagonally through the scene scattering golden sparks. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, painterly brushstrokes, eerie and nightmarish atmosphere.
